deltas.description: Opened a nonduplicate Visual State Transition Graph lane from fresh 2026 GUI state-transition/state-machine/task-state research and grounded it as UnifiedDB canonical transition records plus derived ClayGraph topology rather than a second GUI semantic architecture.

Converted partial observability/hidden-operation blindness into an explicit VISUAL_ALIAS_CONFLICT falsifier and abstention gate instead of treating high visual similarity as sufficient state identity.

Added a concrete invariant that task/progress state cannot advance from visual similarity or retrieved memory; advancement requires verified effect/outcome identity. This maps external TSR evidence into Frank's existing authority/re-entry architecture without adding a parallel state model.

Detected and reread concurrent q23 runtime/feature-tap work at commit a34fa5e8b08c80e2e9e4b527384dc0bc6bd57236; kept VSTG lane non-overlapping and bound it to the feature-tap work as parent runtime evidence.
